'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Joe Pinto DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Pinto]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
